text: dsh-dolphindb 是面向 DSH 的 DolphinDB 集成，提供 WebSocket 执行器、模型工具和浏览器设置卡。它注册只读查询、需审批的写入及服务器切换工具，并把随包提供的 DolphinDB 技能接入技能目录。查询可返回表格并请求图表，服务器配置支持多环境切换。适合在 DSH 中查询和管理 DolphinDB 数据、使用相关技能的开发与数据工作者。运行需可达的 DolphinDB 服务，并配置对应的密码凭据引用。

dsh-dolphindb connects DolphinDB to DSH with a WebSocket executor, query and approval-gated write tools, server switching, and bundled skills. Queries return bounded tables and charts. It suits DSH users working with DolphinDB; a reachable server and password credential are required.

dsh-dolphindb 的「DolphinDB 查询」功能：通过 dolphindb_query 执行只读脚本或 SQL，可传入脚本、.dos 文件、行数限制及服务器名，并以表格返回有界结果。还可按列请求折线、柱状、散点或面积图。
dsh-dolphindb 的「审批后写入」功能：dolphindb_execute 接收脚本或 .dos 文件以及可选服务器，先展示待执行内容并请求用户批准；获准后才调用执行器运行可能修改数据的脚本。
dsh-dolphindb 的「切换服务器」功能：调用 dolphindb_switch 并提供已配置的服务器名，更新持久化设置中的 active 项；后续未指定服务器的查询和写入使用新的活动环境。
dsh-dolphindb 的「DolphinDB 技能目录」功能：插件扫描随包提供的技能目录并解析 SKILL.md 元数据；DSH 技能服务可列出技能候选项，并按名称取得技能定义和正文。
dsh-dolphindb 使用前须知：每个 DolphinDB 服务器需配置 passwordRef 对应的凭据；默认本地配置引用 DOLPHINDB_PASSWORD，执行器按连接解析凭据，未配置时查询会报错。

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · dsh-dolphindb：DolphinDB integration for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) as an installable profile bundle. One package ships the WebSocket executor, the model-facing query/write tools, and the 23 bundled DolphinDB skills.

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · What you get：| Component | Surface |
|---|---|
| `dolphindb_query` | Read-only DolphinDB scripts/SQL (result tables, vectors, matrices, scalars; optional chart; optional `server` override) |
| `dolphindb_execute` | Write/mutation scripts, gated behind the approval seam with a code preview (optional `server` override) |
| `dolphindb_switch` | Switch the active server environment; persisted in the `dolphindb` settings section and hot-applied |
| 23 DolphinDB skills | Bundled `SKILL.md` trees (syntax, SQL, vectorization, functional programming, data import, factors, ops, Orca DStream, plotting, backtest, FICC pricing, Tushare/CSMAR, …) exposed through the `skill` tool |

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb
```

or add `@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb` to a profile's `dsh.profile.bundles` list after `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`.

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · Servers and environments：The executor runs a named server registry. The bundle ships one `local` server
(`127.0.0.1:8848` / `admin`, credential ref `DOLPHINDB_PASSWORD`) as the
deployment default. Real deployments live in the `dolphindb` settings section —
`$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`, hot-reloaded, and editable from web Settings →
Plugins once `@tradercjz/dsh-client-dolphindb` is installed:

```yaml
dolphindb:
  active: prod
  servers:
    prod:

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · Servers and environments：Each password is resolved per connection through the credentials seam: set the
referenced name in the process environment / managed credential store, never
the value in YAML. `dolphindb_switch` changes `active` (persisted); the `server`
argument on `dolphindb_query` / `dolphindb_execute` overrides per call. A
profile patch may instead replace the executor row's whole `config` for a
fixed deployment.

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · Verify the layer：```sh
dsh --profile <name> --dump-config
```

The output shows a `# == @tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb` layer mounting three rows — `dolphindb` (executor), `tool-dolphindb` (tools), `dolphin-skills` (skills). Starting the profile registers `dolphindb_query` / `dolphindb_execute` / `dolphindb_switch` and exposes the 23 `dolphindb-*` skills through the `skill` tool.

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · Development：The repo type-checks and builds against a sibling `deepseek-harness` checkout (see `tsconfig.json`):

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck   # against ../deepseek-harness
pnpm run build       # tsc -b + tsdown → lib/
```

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · Development：`dsh plugin add github:…` installs source, so pnpm runs `prepare` (a self-contained `tsdown` transpile with no harness checkout and no type check). The first install fails until the profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` authorizes the build scripts (the `dsh` error prints the exact commit-pinned key — prefer that over the loose form below):

  # Native file-watcher pulled transitively by the `dolphindb` client

@tradercjz/dsh-dolphindb README · Skills provenance：The `assets/skills/` trees are vendored from the official [`dolphindb/DolphinX_Skill`](https://github.com/dolphindb/DolphinX_Skill) repository. One source `SKILL.md` (`dolphindb-daily-factor`) had an unquoted `description` that breaks YAML parsing; the vendored copy quotes it.
